content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DU Recruitment 2026 by Email
content_sections.text: Prepare a comprehensive Curriculum Vitae (CV). Write a brief Statement of Purpose (maximum 500 words) highlighting relevant expertise in constitutional or disability law. Email the application to [email protected] . Use the subject line "Application for [Post Name] – NLUD ARC Grant". Applications must be received on or before 21 days from publication at 11:59 PM IST. Email it on or before 16 December 2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 16 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 7 vacancies: 1 Research Associate, 2 Field Investigators, 4 Project Interns.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for DU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 16 December 2026. There is no online form.

faq.answer: It depends on the post: INR 35,000/month for Research Associate, INR 20,000/month for Field Investigators, INR 5,000/month for Project Interns.
